description: Get one lending market with every reserve it contains: supplied, supply APR, borrowed, borrow APR, utilization and risk tier per reserve. Spoke ids look like aave-v4-10-etherfi-cash. Aave V4 hub parents (aave-v4-1-hub-global-dollar) are composed from the spokes that share that hub; /v1/markets does not serve those ids.

marketId.description: Market id from list_markets. Spoke example: aave-v4-10-etherfi-cash. Hub example: aave-v4-1-hub-global-dollar.

name: get_market
